# D3 bounded rejection matrix. seq mode: each group = [mutant frame, known-good control].
# Control = 5a03020000 (maxPls 0). A positive control firing after a reject proves the
# reject did not poison the observation path (decoder is stateless per call).
# Valid baselines: A=5a03020000 (op03 maxPls), op26 sub1=5a26050100000000 (hwBtn),
# op27 sub1=5a27020100 (batteryLevel).

# D3-1 truncate A by one byte (drop last payload byte)
5a030200
5a03020000

# D3-2 truncate A to header-only (before payload)
5a03
5a03020000

# D3-3 invalid declared length: plen too large (buf[2]=3, actual payload 2)
5a03030000
5a03020000

# D3-4 invalid declared length: plen too small (buf[2]=1, actual payload 2)
5a03010000
5a03020000

# D3-5 magic-byte mutation (buf[0]=0x5b)
5b03020000
5a03020000

# D3-6 one payload-byte mutation: op26 unknown subcommand (sub=0x09, valid 1..4)
5a26050900000000
5a03020000

# D3-7 unknown command (op=0x7f, no dispatch entry)
5a7f020000
5a03020000

# D3-8 unknown subcommand: op27 sub=0x03 (valid 1,2)
5a27020300
5a03020000

# D3-9 min legal payload: op03 plen=0 (len=3, passes length gate)
5a0300
5a03020000

# D3-10 min legal payload: op26 sub1 trimmed to plen=1 (gate passes, sub handler starved)
5a260101
5a03020000

# D3-11 max legal payload: op03 plen=0xff (255 payload bytes, gate passes)

5a03020000
